subject: lang-dy
title: LANG.DY.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-40 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two), first of two on book p184. Accompanies Braxton's claim that 'the importance of defining terms cannot be overemphasized if we are to view social reality.' (C)LANG-DY (the concept of language dynamics) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics): the question is what language-dynamics produces when crossed with political-dynamics — language being the operational vehicle of definition, political-dynamics being the mechanism that determines whose definitions count. POL-DY sits at the upper-center. IST-F-ALGN and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branch from the main line. IST-F-ALGN carries RE-DOC (redocumentation), which carries RE-ST (restructuralism); PROG-CONT carries (R)TM (the reality of terminology, or terms of a definition). APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) also branches from the main line and carries AF-COMP (affinity compression), which carries CU-AF-B (culture affinity basis) and INFO-DS (information dissemination); INT (intention) branches from INFO-DS.
